headline: 4 contracts catalogued on Ethereum and Polygon zkEVM; core bridge and global exit root manager identified
short_headline: Bridge + Exit Root Manager on Ethereum & L2

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search for 'Polygon zkEVM Bridge' on Ethereum identified primary bridge at 0x2a3DD3EB832aF982ec71669E178424b10Dca2EDe
Polygon documentation on PolygonZkEVMBridgeV2.sol confirms bridge deployed on Ethereum and all Polygon rollups; no formal deployed addresses doc found at /docs/deployments or /docs/addresses
No audit links recorded in per-protocol context; no audit PDFs available for scope extraction

GitHub repositories identified: 0xPolygon/zkevm-bridge-ui (frontend), 0xPolygon/zkevm-bridge-service (off-chain service), and 0xPolygonHermez/zkevm-contracts (core contracts); no broadcast or hardhat-deploy artifacts accessible
Single chain in scope (Ethereum L1); protocol operates with L2 counterpart on Polygon zkEVM but assessment limited to L1 mainnet
No factory pattern identified; bridge is singleton contract managing all assets
Bridge contract role identified as core protocol contract; Global Exit Root Manager referenced but address not yet enumerated

rationale.verdict: Discovery phase catalogued 1 primary bridge contract on Ethereum (0x2a3DD3EB832aF982ec71669E178424b10Dca2EDe) and identified supporting infrastructure (frontend UI, off-chain bridge service, and core contract repository). Further on-chain reading required to identify Global Exit Root Manager and proxy admin addresses.

evidence.shows: Polygon (Matic): zkEVM Bridge contract confirmed at address 0x2a3DD3EB832aF982ec71669E178424b10Dca2EDe on Ethereum mainnet; labeled with Etherscan name tag
Bridge contract deployed on Ethereum and all Polygon rollups; responsible for managing token interactions with other networks; uses ERC1967 proxy pattern for upgradeability
Off-chain bridge service repository; configuration references bridge deployment; mentions PolygonBridgeAddress and PolygonZkEVMGlobalExitRootAddress in config
Official bridge UI repository for Polygon CDK Bridge; provides user interface to bridge ETH and ERC-20 tokens between Ethereum and Polygon networks; contains deployment environment variables
L2BEAT analysis confirms shared bridge contract on Ethereum escrows user funds; mentions PolygonRollupManager and bridge accounting proofs; identifies Security Council and Admin multisigs

unknowns: D2-offchain: Official 'Deployed Contracts' documentation page not accessible; canonical address list not verified at /docs/deployments or /docs/addresses
D4: GitHub broadcast/hardhat-deploy artifacts not accessible to pin contract ABIs and SHAs
D6-offchain: Global Exit Root Manager contract address not yet enumerated; accessible from bridge contract but requires on-chain read
D7: Proxy admin address(es) for bridge ERC1967 proxy not yet identified; required on-chain inspection

protocol_metadata.about: Polygon zkEVM Bridge is a canonical cross-chain bridge contract enabling the transfer of ETH and ERC-20 tokens between Ethereum mainnet and Polygon zkEVM layer 2. The bridge uses Merkle tree proofs to verify token claims and implements an emergency state mechanism for protocol security. It supports arbitrary messages and asset bridging with global exit root coordination.
